brief.headline: Binance hack drains funds; Tether and Circle freeze coins
brief.detail: Binance temporarily suspended withdrawals after an apparent hack, and hackers may have taken at least $1.7 billion, with Tether and Circle freezing billions in coins.

brief.headline: Amazon sinks as AI spending eclipses fastest cloud growth
brief.detail: Amazon shares sank as AI spending overshadowed its fastest cloud growth in five years, following a rare double earnings miss.

brief.headline: Intel plunges on major guidance miss
brief.detail: Intel shares plunged after a major guidance miss, and analysts say further downside is possible, though selling now won't erase losses already taken.

brief.headline: DoorDash strikes $17 billion deal for Instacart
brief.detail: DoorDash agreed to a $17 billion deal for US rival Instacart in a mega grocery delivery bet, according to Reuters.

brief.headline: US third-quarter GDP beats forecasts at 3.4%
brief.detail: Third-quarter U.S. GDP rose a better-than-expected 3.4% even as September inflation accelerated, according to CNBC.
